decisions.reason: As a flagship product with repeated gold-award recognition in 2023 and 2024, this premium stollen clearly exceeds likely aspiration levels, so a boundedly rational bakery with no visible distress has little reason to reallocate its resources away from it.

This bread remained actively presented through 2024 and fits closely with the firm's established bread-making capabilities, so its continued presence suggests performance at least around aspiration and enough organisational slack to keep it unless results deteriorate.

This marzipan stollen stayed prominently offered through 2024, matches the firm's traditional confectionery and seasonal strengths, and in a growing industry a satisfactory adjacent product is more likely to be retained than dropped.
